title: Web Breach Chain: Recon to Root
summary: Chain TCP connect scanning, HTTP surface mapping, a reflected-XSS foothold, and a JWT alg:none privilege escalation into a single end-to-end web breach proof.
description: A multi-skill capstone that walks the full intrusion path against a synthetic web estate. Start from an empty network view, use nmap TCP connect scans to find the edge host and read its service beacon, fingerprint the HTTP surface and discover a hidden developer route, exploit a reflected cross-site scripting sink to steal an analyst session, forge an alg:none JSON Web Token to reach the internal admin console, and finally chain every recovered token into the root proof. All hosts, tokens, and flags are synthetic and the network is internal-only; the privilege escalation is an application-layer simulation because the containers are hardened (read-only, no-new-privileges, all capabilities dropped).
